{{< include _VetResearchLMM-macros.txt >}}

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# HTML figures are drawn as PNG and kept as WebP: lossless, or lossy at quality 90 when that is less than half the
# size. The PDF figures stay vector graphics. Any failure of magick (not installed, no WebP, or a broken
# installation whose system libraries are missing) keeps the PNG
webp <- function(path) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output() || !grepl(pattern = "[.]png$", x = path)) return(path)
  tryCatch(
      {
        if (!requireNamespace("magick", quietly = TRUE) || !isTRUE(magick::magick_config()$webp)) return(path)
        img <- magick::image_read(path)
        out <- sub(pattern = "[.]png$", replacement = ".webp", x = path)
        tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".webp")
        magick::image_write(
            image   = img
          , path    = out
          , format  = "webp"
          , quality = 100
          , defines = c(`webp:lossless` = "true")
          )
        magick::image_write(image = img, path = tmp, format = "webp", quality = 90)
        if (file.size(tmp) < file.size(out) / 2) file.copy(from = tmp, to = out, overwrite = TRUE)
        unlink(c(path, tmp))
        out
      }
    , error = function(e) path
    )
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = FALSE, comment = "", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.2,
                      dev = if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "cairo_pdf" else "ragg_png", dpi = 96,
                      fig.process = webp)
if (requireNamespace("VetResearchLMM", quietly = TRUE)) library(VetResearchLMM) else
  pkgload::load_all(export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
```


# Abstract

The engine of **VetResearchLMM** is checked in two ways: against every number the book prints for the data it gives
in full, and against established R packages on unbalanced data. The book's numbers are reproduced (one printed
value is truncated), and the likelihoods, variance components, Satterthwaite and Kenward-Roger degrees of freedom
and least-squares means agree with **lme4**, **lmerTest**, **pbkrtest**, **nlme** and **emmeans**.

# The published values

```{r}
ref <-
  vlm_reference(
      source   = NULL
    , evaluate = TRUE
    , level    = 1
    )
c(values = nrow(ref), agree = sum(ref$agrees))
ref[agrees == FALSE, c("id", "value", "computed", "note")]
```

# Against other packages

These checks run in the tests of the package (`tests/testthat/test-engine.R`) when the packages are installed.

```{r cross, eval = requireNamespace("lmerTest", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("nlme", quietly = TRUE)}
d <- ex31
d$cell <- interaction(d$drug, d$dose, drop = TRUE)
fm <-
  vlm_fit(
      fixed    = PCV2 ~ drug + drug:dose
    , data     = ex31
    , random   = ~ drug:herd
    , repeated = NULL
    , method   = c("REML", "ML", "Type3")
    , ddfm     = "satterth"
    , type     = 3
    , class    = c("herd", "dose")
    , bound    = TRUE
    , control  = list()
    )
lt <- lmerTest::lmer(formula = PCV2 ~ 0 + cell + (1 | drug:herd), data = d)
ct <- lmerTest::contest(lt, rbind(c(0.5, -1, 0.5)), joint = TRUE)
data.frame(package = c("VetResearchLMM", "lmerTest"), F = c(fm$tests$F[1L], ct[["F value"]]),
           den_df = c(fm$tests$den_df[1L], ct[["DenDF"]]))
ar <-
  vlm_fit(
      fixed    = PCV ~ breed + breed:time
    , data     = ex33
    , random   = NULL
    , repeated = vlm_repeated(
          type    = c("vc", "cs", "ar1", "sp_pow", "un")[4]
        , subject = ~ animal_id:breed
        , order   = ~ time
        )
    , method   = c("REML", "ML", "Type3")
    , ddfm     = c("default", "contain", "residual", "betwithin", "satterth", "kr")
    , type     = 3
    , class    = NULL
    , bound    = TRUE
    , control  = list()
    )
ex33$sub <- interaction(ex33$animal_id, ex33$breed, drop = TRUE)
g <-
  nlme::gls(
      model       = PCV ~ breed + breed:time
    , data        = ex33
    , correlation = nlme::corExp(form = ~ time | sub)
    , method      = "REML"
    )
c(VetResearchLMM = -ar$fit$value[1L] / 2, nlme = as.numeric(stats::logLik(g)))
```

# Differences from the book

* **Data.** Version 1.1.0 had three typing errors in `ex33` (two measurement days and a trailing space in an animal
  identifier); with them, the variances of Example 3.3 were 5.522 and 4.943 instead of the printed 5.478 and 4.965.
  Version 2.0.0 corrects them.
* **Containment degrees of freedom of random coefficient models.** For Model 3 of Example 3.3, SAS 6.12 (used by the
  book) gives the fixed effects 144 or 10 degrees of freedom by rules that later versions of SAS changed; the
  package follows the current containment rule (the random effect `time` per animal contains `breed*time`), which
  gives 10. The estimates and standard errors agree.
* **Information criteria.** SAS 6.12 printed the "larger is better" forms $\ell - d$ and
  $\ell - \tfrac{d}{2}\log(N - P)$; they are given next to the current forms.
* **Rounding.** The book rounds or truncates some numbers computed from rounded variance components (for example
  1.0975 and 0.698 in Example 2.5.3.1); they are compared at the precision that the book's own computation supports.
